capabilities: Display a heatmap of words written per day
Show words written vs removed for a selected day
Show files created vs removed for a selected day
Open the heatmap from the ribbon or command palette
extras: Only works partly with Obsidian Sync: synced changes appear as if written on the day the sync happened, and the plugin must be installed on both devices before writing.
problem: Obsidian counts words in the current note but gives no long-term view of writing activity across days and folders.
summary: GitHub-style heatmap plugin that tracks words written per day and shows daily word and file changes per day.
